Title: Speaking AI Language Teacher | Lucas: Learn English, Spanish, German, French & more by talking | Product Hunt
Speaking AI Language Teacher | Lucas. ## Learn English, Spanish, German, French & more by talking. Call our AI language tutor like on the phone to learn to speak English, Spanish, German, Italian, Portuguese or French! There's no need to be embarrassed You are talking to an AI with endless patience Do real personalized courses from beginner to advanced. Launch tags:Android•Education•Languages. Framer AI AgentsDesign and publish professional sites with AI. No reviews yetBe the first to leave a review for Speaking AI Language Teacher | Lucas. I am German and my wife is Colombian so i really need to learn Spanish quickly. I tried Duolingo for some time and I got a lot of awards and streaks but I still could not speak or understand Spanish at all... and I guess that's why because you don't actually speak with these apps - you do multiple choice tests. ChatGPT & co allowed AI finally to speak decently so I started building my own personal language teacher. Now everybody can have his or her own personal language teacher who is always available when you have a few minutes and you don't need to be embarrassed anymore - it's only an AI :) There is a free trial available so please just check out  and finally start speaking (!) your dream language! Congrats on the launch @karsten\_wysk ! what database did you use for teaching the Ai how to speak and detect the languages? @lumi\_nertan i am just using GPT4o in the backend and the user selects his language himself :). Applying AI to education to improve user learning efficiency is a worthwhile endeavor. I have been talking to Lucas over the last weeks and it has been great fun. My talking - (in Spanish) - has constantly improved day by day, especially with the help of the mails that were sent to me after each session with Lucas. The only way to really learn a language is by speaking and Lucas seems to be the perfect solution! This is great, congratulations on your launch! Will you be adding more languages soon? Which language are you looking for? @karsten\_wysk It's a bit niche but Hungarian!
